The dish looks like scrambled eggs with greens (spinach or arugula) and a bit of tomato, possibly with cheese, on a white plate.

For scale, the plate is about 400 px across. If it is a dinner plate of about 26 cm, that gives roughly 0.065 cm per px. The food pile measures about 230 px wide by 250 px tall, which is roughly 15 cm by 16 cm, though the actual shape is irregular and covers perhaps 120 cm² of the plate.

Scrambled egg at about 2 cm thick over that area would be around 150 g if solid, but it is fluffy and not fully covering the area, so I estimate about 150 g in total.

Scrambled eggs with oil or butter run about 1.6 kcal/g. Cheese and greens change that only slightly, so 150 g comes to roughly 240 kcal.
